items.exampleEn: It's important to keep a balance between work and family.
items.exampleZh: 在工作和家庭之間保持平衡很重要。

items.exampleEn: Working from home is a growing trend.
items.exampleZh: 在家工作是越來越普遍的趨勢。

items.exampleEn: Stress can make it hard to sleep.
items.exampleZh: 壓力可能讓人難以入睡。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your contribution to our team.
items.exampleZh: 謝謝你對我們團隊的貢獻。

items.exampleEn: There has been a big improvement in her English.
items.exampleZh: 她的英文有很大的進步。

items.exampleEn: We have only limited time, so let's start now.
items.exampleZh: 我們時間有限，所以現在就開始吧。

items.exampleEn: There has been a decline in the number of young farmers.
items.exampleZh: 年輕農夫的人數減少了。

items.exampleEn: The country slowly recovered from the depression.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家慢慢從經濟蕭條中復甦。

items.sentenceEn: This offer is available for a limited time only.
items.sentenceZh: 這項優惠只在有限的時間內提供。

items.audioEn: Sales of paper books are in decline, but online sales are growing.
items.audioZh: 紙本書的銷量在下滑，但網路銷量在成長。

items.sentenceEn: A short walk helps me forget the stress of work.
items.sentenceZh: 散個步能幫我忘掉工作的壓力。

items.sentenceEn: The new manager made several improvements to the office.
items.sentenceZh: 新經理對辦公室做了幾項改善。

items.stemEn: Short skirts are the latest ____ this summer.
items.stemZh: 短裙是今年夏天最新的潮流。

items.stemEn: Check the ____ of your bank account before you go shopping.
items.stemZh: 去購物前先查一下你的銀行帳戶餘額。

items.passageEn: For many years, the main street of our town saw a decline in visitors. Shop owners felt a lot of stress because their income was limited. Then a new trend began: young people opened small cafes and art shops there. Each new shop made a contribution to the street's new life. The improvement was obvious within two years. Now the street has a good balance of old and new shops, and it is busy again on weekends.
items.passageZh: 多年來，我們鎮上的大街遊客越來越少。店家因為收入有限，壓力很大。後來出現了一股新潮流：年輕人在那裡開起了小咖啡店和藝術小店。每一家新店都為這條街的新生命做出了貢獻。兩年內就有明顯的改善。現在這條街新舊商店的比例很平衡，週末又熱鬧起來了。

questions.questionZh: 店家過去為什麼壓力很大？
大街上出現了什麼新潮流？
options: 年輕人開咖啡店和藝術店
整條老街道改建成停車場

items.promptZh: 在那段經濟不景氣的時期，很多人失業了。
referenceEn: Many people lost their jobs during the depression.
During the economic depression, a lot of people lost their jobs.
rubricZh: depression 在這裡指「經濟不景氣」，前面通常加 the、economic 等
過去的事用過去式（例如 lost）

items.instructionZh: 用 stress 造一個句子，說說你怎麼減輕壓力。
referenceEn: When I feel stress, I go for a walk.
Listening to music helps me reduce stress.
rubricZh: stress 在這裡是名詞「壓力」，不可數
可用 feel stress、reduce stress 等說法
說的是自己的習慣（例如 I、me）
